properties.nt: Egyptian-held Nile reach from Aswan to the Semna border: "it was under the twelfth dynasty ( — 1991 to — 1786) that Nubia was effectively occupied as far as Semna, where the southern border of the kingdom was firmly established." (GHA II p.255). Only the Nile valley between the named places is drawn; the width of the band is not from the source.
properties.nta: الامتداد المصري على النيل من أسوان حتى حدود سمنة وفق المصدر المذكور؛ عرض الشريط غير مأخوذ من المصدر.
properties.gs: quoted place limits: band about 13 km (0.12 deg) around straight segments joining Aswan, Qasr Ibrim, Faras, Buhen and Semna (db/cities.json coordinates, Wikidata P625, CC0)
